result:
The privilege was never declared, so no row existed for roles to be granted. The report code enforces `App: Can generate a Visit Summary`, but nothing registered it. Only superusers pass `Context.requirePrivilege`, so everyone else was blocked. The fix was PR #31, which added the declaration to `config.xml`, under ticket O3-5667.

**Why it happened**

- `openmrs-module-patientdocuments/api/src/main/java/org/openmrs/module/patientdocuments/reports/VisitSummaryPdfReport.java:89` calls `Context.requirePrivilege(PatientDocumentsPrivilegeConstants.VIEW_VISIT_SUMMARY)` before generating the PDF.
- The constant is defined as `"App: Can generate a Visit Summary"` in `openmrs-module-patientdocuments/api/src/main/java/org/openmrs/module/patientdocuments/common/PatientDocumentsPrivilegeConstants.java:18`.
- Before the fix, that name did not appear in `omod/src/main/resources/config.xml`. The module declares privileges there, so OpenMRS never created the privilege row at startup. Without a row, no role could be granted it, and only superusers got through.

**The fix**

- Commit `9fc46c2cf8f6b7d3f2758379ac9b7af2d848b22a` ("Declare Visit Summary privilege in config.xml (#31)") adds a `<privilege>` block for `App: Can generate a Visit Summary` to `openmrs-module-patientdocuments/omod/src/main/resources/config.xml:55-58`, following the pattern of the sticker and encounter-forms privileges above it. The PR body confirms the diagnosis: the privilege was enforced but never declared, so it was un-grantable.
- The change is PR #31, merged 2026-07-20, and it is linked to ticket O3-5667.

**Related code, not part of the fix**

- The visit summary controllers also check this privilege and log failures: `VisitSummaryPreviewController.java:80`, `VisitSummarySectionsController.java:79` and `VisitSummaryPdfExportController.java:76`, all under `openmrs-module-patientdocuments/omod/src/main/java/org/openmrs/module/patientdocuments/web/rest/controller/`.
- In the frontend, `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-label-printing-app/src/print-visit-summary/print-visit-summary-action-button.component.tsx:35` gates the print button with `UserHasAccess privilege="App: Can generate a Visit Summary"`, using the same privilege name.
- Later commit `fc5dbea3458f9334a13aa38179b2f4f36e90e76e` (O3-5678, PR #38) changed the page size of the visit summary. It is unrelated to the privilege.
